acceptanceCriteria: A coverage record can name ID:path entries with an evidence commit per repository, and e2e-safe accepts it when each commit matches the bound repository revision.
A mismatched or missing per-repository commit fails closed as e2e-map-stale.
Spec requirement(s) recorded with acceptance evidence.
body: Residual from V1-1676 (PR #1084) and prerequisite for V1-1675 (#1078). application-flow-coverage/0 records carry one evidence commit and root-relative paths, so a record naming a path in a separate test or application repository cannot be pinned; V1-1675's design fails such records closed as e2e-map-stale. Expected: a coverage record version that names ID:path entries and an evidence commit per repository, verified against the bound repository revisions. Actual: only a root commit.
title: application-flow-coverage: per-repository evidence commits so e2e-safe can trust foreign-repository coverage paths
